doc: Reset password/PIN (and optionally switch between them). Unlocks the account.

Read-only map of exactly what a person can open, do and see. Logged.
This is NOT impersonation: no session is created as that person.
Names shown on the shared-tablet sign-in screen (PIN accounts only).
Admin-edited wording that replaces the built-in translations.
Cheap poll for the top-bar bell.

People you may start a direct chat with. Staff reach managers (and admins
only if the admin allows it) — owner answer, 26 Oct 2026.
The discussion attached to one batch, lot, receipt, order, task …
Counter counts what actually arrived. Any shortage is written off visibly.
Reprints the same bill — never creates a new sale (DPR §9, S16).
The saved register of a closed day (what was true at the moment of closing).

Admin reopens today's counter (e.g. closed too early). The old close and its
register stay in history marked REOPENED; the day must be closed again.
Ask to correct a lot (spillage, moisture, found stock). Someone else approves.

After importing into Tally, record what Tally said. Accepted vouchers are
locked; a rejected batch frees its vouchers for a corrected export.
Check the whole workbook (apply=false) or save it (apply=true). Rows with problems are never saved.
The owner checks the figures and presses We're live: stock becomes real lots, dues open in Finance.
Returning customer card for the cashier: name, visits, last bill with today's prices.
Owner/admin set the 4-digit view PIN. Changing an existing PIN needs the old one.
Owner/admin note what actually came in: cash taken from the drawer, UPI seen in the bank app.
Sign out one other device ({"id": n}) or every other device ({"all": true}). This device stays signed in.

Admin edits a record. Changing kg-per-bag affects only future receipts;
switching a record off hides it from new entries but keeps its history.

Match the supplier invoice to a receipt. Invoice facts never change kg
(DPR §5). Payment status comes from approved supplier payments.

Undo a wrongly entered receipt with compensating movements — only while
none of its stock has been used (DPR §18: no deletes, no silent edits).

Roasting register. ?day=YYYY-MM-DD lists one day (IST); ?month=YYYY-MM gives
a per-day summary for the calendar; no filter = latest 100.

What can be linked when assigning work: kinds, people (with what they're allowed
to do), open packing tickets and open orders.

Manual progress is only for general work; linked work counts itself.
Anyone doing the work can flag it stuck. Completion goes through /submit.
The person who did the work marks it completed; it then waits for review.
{section: {count, tasks[], waiting[]}} for the sections this person can open.
Changing the formula makes a new version; old jobs keep the version they used.

One packing session: coffee actually used, good packs, rejected packs.
Finished packs are created on QA hold — never just because a task is ticked.
Payment received before dispatch for a non-credit order (verified by finance).
Price-hidden operational slip (O-37, BR-048).
